scope: Named iScience reference and at most two new primary reference leads; physical real tennis ball translational speed paired with raw video, calibration, synchronization, independent references and compatible speed definition
query_notes: Exact DOI/title queries plus targeted data-availability, supplementary and repository terms returned publisher abstract and Crossmark metadata, without an identified raw-data repository.

A bounded discovery query for tennis speed video/radar references and video/mocap datasets selected two new leads: Bern continuous decision-making under uncertainty and Foo et al. smart tennis ball. Existing CalTennis/NKUST/Bath/TennisEye/TrackNet/MUVY sources were not re-audited.
Only primary publisher, author repository, DOI-depositor metadata and institutional archive content was used for conclusions. Secondary search hits were not accepted as evidence.

sources.name: Shi, Lv and Wang iScience 2026
access_observations: ScienceDirect/Cell full-text HTTP 403; no login, gate bypass or paid access attempted.
Elsevier lowercase pii XML endpoint HTTP 200 with 1940 characters of core metadata only, no full article text.
Explicit PII FULL-view endpoint HTTP 429; this request was not retried.
Crossref HTTP 200 and article VOR CC BY 4.0 metadata.
Europe PMC exact DOI metadata search HTTP 200 with hitCount 0; this is index evidence only, not evidence of absent data.
sources.decision: Reference-design lead remains unresolved; no qualifying raw package established, and no claim that the data are absent or request-only.

sources.name: Bern continuous decision-making under uncertainty in tennis
sources.decision: Author README explicitly describes XR tennis and human body C3D skeletons; real physical ball/video/reference calibration package not established. No media acquired.

sources.name: Foo, Li and Ghannam smart tennis ball
sources.data_statement_paraphrase: Supporting data contained in the article; additional information through corresponding author request.
sources.decision: Instrumented foam ball orientation/spin prototype does not establish a paired real-flight translational speed dataset with calibrated synchronized source video. No outreach or media acquired.

limitations: A metadata-access failure or bounded search cannot prove that no release exists. Reported paper performance does not qualify this project's pipeline.
